name: Sofia Ramirez Garcia
bio:
Sofia's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for the technical intricacies of racing simulators. As a child, she spent countless hours dissecting the mechanics of racing games, driven by a desire to understand how these virtual experiences mirrored the real world. This led her to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, where she specialized in computational fluid dynamics and vehicle dynamics. Her academic work impressed Century Motorsport, who recruited her to their simulator program.

At Century Motorsport, Sofia quickly proved herself as a valuable asset. She has a knack for identifying subtle discrepancies between the simulated and real-world performance of the cars, contributing valuable insights that have helped the team refine their setups and improve driver training. Her ambition to continuously improve her skills, coupled with her innovative approach to problem-solving, has made her a rising star in the team. She is known for her meticulous attention to detail and her ability to translate complex technical data into actionable insights for the drivers and engineers.

Sofia's distinctive contribution lies in her relentless pursuit of accuracy and realism in the simulator environment. She constantly seeks out new methods and technologies to enhance the fidelity of the simulations, ensuring that the team's drivers are as prepared as possible for the challenges of the track. She is loyal to Century Motorsport and sees herself as instrumental in the team achieving future success.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a high ponytail
physical.description: Sofia is of average height with a lean, athletic build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Drinks mate during long simulation sessions.
